messages:
Sam Turner: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem. I'm consolidating remediation items into this thread so we can assign owners and Jira links. Goal: owners + tickets by EOD Fri.

Sam Turner: Items: 1) Add query to detect recurring failure pattern (backend retry storms). 2) Create a fallback-rate limit for downstream calls. 3) Update runbook with explicit handoff steps and contact rotation. 4) Backfill last six months of incidents and tag repeats. 5) Add a verification step in the release checklist to run the synthetic cascade test.

Ivy Zhao: I'll take #1 (recurrence query). Will write a SavedQuery and a small dashboard. ETA: 4 business days.

Ivy Zhao: Jira created: TOOLS-4550 "recurrence query + dashboard". Link: https://redwood.app/jira/TOOLS-4550

Marco Ruiz: I can own #2 (fallback rate-limit). Need product to confirm per-tenant policy; can someone loop PM?

Marco Ruiz: Ticket: RUNTIME-9081 "fallback rate-limit implementation". Leaving unassigned until policy confirmed.

Jolie Park: I'll own #3 (runbook + contact rotation). I'll add a RACI table and a short escalation matrix. Proposal: Responsible = oncall owner, Accountable = runtime lead, Consulted = product, Informed = infra. Thoughts?

Sam Turner: RACI looks good to me. Please add oncall roster links and a handoff checklist.

Ivy Zhao: For #4 backfill, I can help if Ops grants read access to archived incidents. @TicketBot can you schedule export of incident logs for the last 6 months?

TicketBot: Export scheduled: incident logs (6 months) -> analytics-bucket (job 2501238000). Reminder set: owner check-in in 48 hours (2501246400).

Marco Ruiz: For #5 (verification in release checklist) I'll add a subtask under RUNTIME-9081 to create the synthetic cascade test and gate on it.

Jolie Park: One more ask: add an incident label "retry-storm" when the recurrence query triggers so we can track regressions easily. I'll file a small tools ticket after TOOLS-4550 data shape is confirmed.

Sam Turner: Summary: owners assigned (TOOLS-4550 Ivy, RUNTIME-9081 Marco, runbook Jolie), export job scheduled, RACI agreed. I'll add these to the remediation tracker after tickets have due dates. Please ACK here.

Ivy Zhao: ACK.

Marco Ruiz: ACK.
